mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_user_vaults (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, channel_type, app_id, actor_id, vault_uuid, identity_uuid) VALUES (#{identity.OrganizationUUID}, #{identity.WorkspaceUUID}, #{identity.ChannelType}, #{identity.AppID}, #{identity.ActorID}, #{vaultUUID}, NULLIF(#{identity.IdentityUUID}, '')::uuid) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, channel_type, app_id, actor_id) DO UPDATE SET vault_uuid = EXCLUDED.vault_uuid, identity_uuid = EXCLUDED.identity_uuid WHERE channel_user_vaults.identity_uuid IS NULL OR channel_user_vaults.identity_uuid = EXCLUDED.identity_uuid
